full_prompt_en: A square isometric game-like illustration shows an industrial outpost and several armored vehicles on a broad dusty plain. The base occupies the center-left of the selected panel, viewed from above at an oblique angle so its roof, walls, and surrounding ground are all visible. A tall red-and-white lattice tower rises from the complex, topped by a round red dome and thin upright antennas. Near its upper right, a large pale circular dish points diagonally upward beside a low red structure. The main cluster below includes gray metal buildings, pipes, vents, small lit windows, and a few red accent panels. Narrow beams and cables tie the structures together, while tiny dark figures or posts around the perimeter emphasize the scale. Several low dark green armored vehicles sit on the open earth: one at far left, others scattered along the lower half and the right edge. Their shapes are compact, with short protruding barrels and shadowed tracks or wheels. The tan ground bears tire-like marks, stones, and irregular darker patches, fading into a near-black upper background with low rocky mounds. The viewpoint is high but not straight down, keeping the tower as the clearest vertical element in a mostly horizontal layout. Diffuse cool light falls from above, while warm yellow illumination glows in small doorways and at the base of the tower. The overall composition centers a complex mechanical landmark within a ring of vehicles, balancing muted desert browns and steel grays against the red tower.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、类似等角游戏画面的插图呈现一座工业前哨和数辆装甲车，分布在宽阔的尘土地上。基地占据所选单图的中左，以斜向俯视角度呈现，屋顶、墙壁和周围地面都可看见。一座红白相间的高格构塔从建筑群升起，顶部有圆形红色罩体和细窄直立的天线。其右上附近，一面大型浅色圆形碟盘在低矮红色结构旁斜指上方。下面的主要建筑群包含灰色金属房屋、管道、通风口、小亮窗及几块红色重音板。细梁与线缆连接结构，外围细小深色人影或柱体强调尺度。几辆低矮深绿色装甲车停在空地上：一辆位于最左，其他散在下半部和右缘。它们形体紧凑，有短短突出的炮管和处于阴影中的履带或车轮。棕褐色地面有类似车辙的痕迹、石头及不规则深色斑块，向上方近黑色背景和低矮岩丘渐隐。视点较高，却并非完全垂直，使塔成为主要由水平形态组成的布局中最清楚的竖向元素。冷调漫射光从上方落下，暖黄色照明则在小门洞及塔基处发亮。整体构图以复杂机械地标为中心、外围散布车辆，用低饱和沙漠棕和钢灰平衡红塔。
style_prompt_en: Isometric game-like imagery organizes small industrial forms through an elevated oblique viewpoint and tightly controlled scale. Muted tan, dust brown, charcoal, and desaturated olive establish the ground, while concentrated red accents identify the central vertical mass. Fine vents, cables, grilles, and scattered gritty marks give the surfaces mechanical density without losing the larger silhouettes. Cool diffuse ambient light keeps most planes subdued, and a few warm localized glows guide attention into openings. Soft dusty falloff reduces contrast toward the perimeter, where broad negative ground surrounds the detailed center. Repeated small rectangular units and low horizontal shapes counterbalance one tall lattice rhythm. The overall effect is strategic, miniature, and weathered.
style_prompt_zh: 等角游戏式图像借高处斜视角与严格控制的尺度组织细小工业形体。低饱和浅棕、尘褐、炭黑和灰橄榄色铺成底面，集中的红色重音指出中央竖向大形体。细小通风口、线缆、格栅和散落的粗颗粒让表面具有机械密度，又不损失更大的剪影。冷调漫射环境光使大多数平面克制，几处局部暖光则把注意力引向开口。带尘感的柔和渐隐降低周缘反差，宽阔空地环绕细节密集的中心。重复的小长方单元与低矮横向形体平衡一处高耸的格构节奏。整体效果具有策略游戏的微缩感和风化质地。
theme_en: An industrial desert outpost with a red communication tower and armored vehicles
theme_zh: 沙漠工业前哨中立着红色通信塔，周围有装甲车辆
name: Command & Conquer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
